children.name:
Let each Runatron installation authenticate as its own runner and report
      immutable agent snapshots. Keep credentials, inventory, and administrator
      provider limits in the product while Runatron authors agent configuration.
terms:
"
      Let each Runatron installation authenticate as its own runner and report
      immutable agent snapshots. Keep credentials, inventory, and administrator
      provider limits in the product while Runatron authors agent configuration.
      "
"Accept versioned, non-secret agent snapshots reported by each runner."
"Runatron is the source of its persona, instructions, tools, skills, delegation, execution, and model configuration."
"Do not author or publish runtime agent definitions in the product."
"Identify an agent by runner installation and runner-local agent ID."
"Identical configurations from separate installations have separate access and history."
"Do not merge agents by name, version, or fingerprint across runners."

children.name: list runner installations for an administrator

Internal current and retained snapshot reads expose owner-validated enabled tool and skill capabilities. Invalid tool selections reject the binding; retained and current capabilities are separate and consumers cannot recompute installation authority.
terms: "Internal current and retained snapshot reads expose owner-validated enabled tool and skill capabilities. Invalid tool selections reject the binding; retained and current capabilities are separate and consumers cannot recompute installation authority."

children.name: A runner key authenticates only its own installation; no runner key can act as a human session or choose the author or destination of a chat reply.
terms: "A runner key authenticates only its own installation; no runner key can act as a human session or choose the author or destination of a chat reply."

children.name: Only the verifier is persisted; a newly issued secret is returned once. Rotation revokes every earlier key before the new key can authorize inventory, claims, permits, or results.
terms: "Only the verifier is persisted; a newly issued secret is returned once. Rotation revokes every earlier key before the new key can authorize inventory, claims, permits, or results."

children.name: Runner-bound operations verify a presented secret against the stored verifier through trusted request authentication; runner ID and key ID supplied in a request never prove identity by themselves.
terms: "Runner-bound operations verify a presented secret against the stored verifier through trusted request authentication; runner ID and key ID supplied in a request never prove identity by themselves."

children.name: Revocation denies all later runner actions, including inventory reports, claims, provider permits, progress, and results.
terms: "Revocation denies all later runner actions, including inventory reports, claims, provider permits, progress, and results."

children.name: A report replaces the complete current inventory atomically. Repeating the same runner, version, and fingerprint has the same result; reusing a version with different content is rejected.
terms: "A report replaces the complete current inventory atomically. Repeating the same runner, version, and fingerprint has the same result; reusing a version with different content is rejected."

children.name: Inventory replacement compares expectedCurrentVersion with the current version; a delayed older report cannot roll back the active inventory. The product verifies the inventory fingerprint against canonical reported content.
terms: "Inventory replacement compares expectedCurrentVersion with the current version; a delayed older report cannot roll back the active inventory. The product verifies the inventory fingerprint against canonical reported content."

children.name: Each runner-local agent ID occurs at most once in one inventory. Historical snapshots remain immutable and readable after an agent disappears.
terms: "Each runner-local agent ID occurs at most once in one inventory. Historical snapshots remain immutable and readable after an agent disappears."

children.name: A removed agent receives no new run; queued and historical runs retain their selected snapshot even after an inventory update.
terms: "A removed agent receives no new run; queued and historical runs retain their selected snapshot even after an inventory update."

children.name: Agent snapshots contain no credentials, provider tokens, or other secrets; those remain with Runatron.
terms: "Agent snapshots contain no credentials, provider tokens, or other secrets; those remain with Runatron."

children.name: A provider has no usable global capacity until an administrator configures its limit. A runner's reported local capacity cannot change the global limit.
terms: "A provider has no usable global capacity until an administrator configures its limit. A runner's reported local capacity cannot change the global limit."

children.name: Reducing a global provider limit below the number of active unexpired permits is rejected; an administrator cannot retroactively invalidate already granted calls.
terms: "Reducing a global provider limit below the number of active unexpired permits is rejected; an administrator cannot retroactively invalidate already granted calls."

children.name: Listing runner installations is read-only inventory visibility for administrators; it never exposes runner key material and grants no runner authority.
terms: "Listing runner installations is read-only inventory visibility for administrators; it never exposes runner key material and grants no runner authority."
